_note: Fixture: canned model output for draft_questions (fixture mode). Each entry becomes one fc_questions row with status=draft.

drafts.prompt: Will the Federal Reserve cut its benchmark rate before December 31, 2026?
drafts.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the Federal Open Market Committee announces a cut to the federal funds target range on or before 2026-12-31, as published in an official FOMC statement. Otherwise NO.

drafts.prompt: Will the national EV battery plant ship sub-$80 per kWh cells before July 1, 2027?
drafts.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the plant operator or a tier-1 auditor publishes delivered cell pricing below $80 per kWh on or before 2027-06-30. Press-release claims without auditor confirmation do not count. Otherwise NO.

drafts.prompt: Will the Atlantic hurricane season produce six or more major hurricanes?
drafts.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the National Hurricane Center's postseason report counts six or more Category 3+ Atlantic storms for the season. Otherwise NO.
